title: KoveeGovernanceOwnerBinding (DESIGN.md §16.6; kovee amendment A1/A2; C2)
description: The §16.6 field list verbatim with the full sage|byom|none enum (kovee amendment A1: the sage arm exists for spec fidelity and is never exercised in this stack). One CAS-protected row per exact governed scope, no overlapping active owner selectors (§16.6 item 1). The greenfield saga (D10) CASes none→byom at the expected revision under the frozen governance_enable authority row — a CAS proves concurrency, not authority (family contract §2.A). GovernanceCutover (sage→none→byom, byom §25) is a different machine (amendment A2).

exact_scope_digest.description: Canonical digest of the exact governed scope; UNIQUE(realm_ref, exact_scope_digest) — cross-record uniqueness and the no-overlapping-active-selectors rule are enforced in code, not expressible here.

revision.description: CAS field: the owner transition commits only at the expected revision (exact-CAS; retry returns the identical binding).

binding_epoch.description: CAS field: the enablement epoch fence. A rolled-back epoch can never activate; re-enablement is a fresh epoch (D10 saga; proof/specs/GreenfieldEnablement.tla NoActivationAfterRollback).

governance_owner.description: Full §16.6 enum verbatim; the sage arm is never exercised in this stack (kovee amendment A1) and byom §25's Sage migration stays documented, unbuilt.

cutover_ref.description: Present only when this row was produced by a GovernanceCutover step (byom §25); the greenfield saga never sets it.

status.description: Closed §16.6 enum. governance_disable freezes the row (active→frozen) with step-up; a frozen row retains its owner arm for audit and holds no active selector.

oneOf.$comment: No owner: the owner refs are absent (cutover_ref may remain during a §25 cutover's none step).
An owning arm names its exact owner endpoint and binding; the greenfield CAS sets both atomically with activation.

identifier.description: Opaque visible-ASCII identifier, at most 128 bytes (§14.9).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§14.2 rejects unsafe integers).

digestRef.$comment: The closed family DigestRef wire (family-vectors/PROFILE.md §6.1, normative; D-R0-1): exactly the members {class, algorithm, key_ref?, value_hex}. The oneOf pins the closed class/algorithm pairing and requires key_ref exactly for the keyed erasure classes; each arm refines members of this already-closed object.

class.description: Digest class (PROFILE.md §6, D-R0-1); substituting one class where a schema requires another is a conformance failure.

key_ref.description: Key id for the keyed erasure classes; raw HMAC keys, per-object secrets, and salts are never part of a DigestRef.

digestRef.description: Typed DigestRef: every digest field is typed, never an unlabelled hash. Wire shape, class/algorithm pairing, and key_ref presence per the ratified family profile.

selector.description: Kovee project/space/scope selector expression, at most 256 visible-ASCII bytes; selector grammar is Kovee-owned (C2 host schemas), byom pins only the bounded opaque wire shape.
